title: Token Micro-Rate Surface & Flow Export: interactive pricing surface and attribution tiles
creator: Priya Nair
description: Design and prototype an interactive 'micro-rate surface' for token-level pricing: a compact surface visualization that maps token position, model variant, and route to a marginal cost curve. The surface will sit in the Console Cost Explorer as a top-level tile and allow users to: 1) hover to see per-token marginal costs, 2) slice by route/model/role, 3) group tokens into exportable attribution buckets, and 4) download CSV/NDJSON of per-invocation line items for chargeback. Deliver a Figma prototype, a short usability script for 5 customer interviews, and handoff assets for frontend and product analytics teams.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype with interactive states (hover, slice, group) linked in artifacts
Export flow defined with CSV/NDJSON schema and sample data
Design review feedback captured and actioned (>=2 PM/Eng sign-offs)
Edge cases documented: long prompt truncation, batched KV cache attribution, and fallback to aggregated view
Handoff packet including tokens-to-cost mapping spec and accessibility considerations
comments: 2026-02-18 — Priya Nair: Kickoff doc drafted; goal is to reduce time-to-root-cause for per-token spend spikes and make chargebacks exportable.
2026-02-22 — A. Chen: Initial wireframes sketched; proposing a compact surface (80px height) with expandable details panel for per-invocation rows.
2026-02-25 — Miguel Soto (Eng): Feasibility note — backend can stream per-token costs but must cap at 500 tokens per invocation for UI performance; suggested server-side sampling for long traces.
2026-03-01 — PM review (Lara O'Neill): Asked to include role-aware attribution (system vs user vs assistant tokens) and ensure CSV column ordering aligns with billing ledger.
2026-03-04 — Design critique: 5 participants; key feedback: prefer sparklines per-route rather than full heatmap for quick scan; color palette needs better contrast for colorblind users.
2026-03-07 — A. Chen: Updated prototype addressing critique: added route sparklines, a colorblind-safe palette, and an 'aggregate only' fallback to avoid heavy rendering on large result sets.
2026-03-10 — Eng review (SRE): Raised concern about exposing raw token metadata; suggested masking prompt text and only surface token hashes in exports for customers who opt-in.
2026-03-12 — Priya Nair: Incorporated SRE advice; export schema updated to include token_hash and token_role, omitted plain prompt fragments. Ready for In Review sign-off.
notes: Tradeoff: full heatmap provides granular signal but costs render time and cognitive load; chose compact surface + expandable rows to balance.
Decision: default UX shows marginal cost per token bucket (system/user/assistant) with toggle to reveal raw per-token rows for power users.
Risk: large-scale exports can be expensive; we'll gate NDJSON exports behind a quota and require admin confirmation.
Follow-up: analytics event schema to measure 'export initiated' and 'export completed' for billing telemetry.
